name: Smile☆Shooter ~First☆Ticket~
original_name: スマイル☆シューター ～ふぁーすと☆ちけっと～
source:
The latest all-ages musical action ADV from Kogado Studio features new idol group Smile☆Shooter, which has been popular on cell phones and Twitter. In the game, you have to help the girls (Yurina, Airi, Mayu) with their debut. It’s a mix of ADV and musical action parts, using the same system as Angelic Serenade and Symphonic Rain. 

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
光荣工作室最新推出的全年龄音乐动作ADV以新晋偶像组合Smile☆Shooter为主角；该组合此前已在手机平台和Twitter上积累了颇高人气。游戏中，你需要帮助由百合奈、爱实和真由组成的少女组合完成出道。本作由ADV和音乐动作部分构成，采用与《天使小夜曲》和《交响乐之雨》相同的系统。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/01/01/january-2011-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
